description: Horizontal strip of pills, one per regulatory anchor. Each pill shows the regulator prefix (e.g. APRA) + the full reference string (version embedded in reference text). Pure charter.regulatoryAnchors[] read.

fieldDependencies.displayAs: One pill per anchor. Pill shows: regulator badge (charter.regulatoryAnchors[].regulator) + reference text (charter.regulatoryAnchors[].reference). Widget accepts legacy aliases: framework→regulator, name/title→reference.

_fieldNameDivergenceNote: Confirmed from exports/fmt-credit-writeup-v1.3.1/charter.jsonld: regulatoryAnchors[] items use 'regulator' (not 'framework') and 'reference' (not 'name', 'title', or 'versionPin'). Version information is embedded inline in the 'reference' string (e.g. 'FMT Internal Credit Policy v3.2 — ...'). There is NO separate versionPin field on regulatoryAnchors — that field exists only on knowledgeAnchors[].
